comparison.objective: Open a stiff quarter-turn valve using a loose tube fitted over its short handle as a cheater bar.
comparison.physical_skill: Tube-over-handle alignment followed by high-torque rotational leverage.
comparison.success_condition: Valve opened through the required quarter-turn using the tube; body and numeric torque/end-angle rubric are absent.
comparison.reason: Tool fitting and sustained torque differ from axial mandrel alignment plus transient hammer impact, sacrificial fracture, and fragment recovery.
